questions.stem: 當公車遲遲不來時，騎共享機車通勤比在站牌乾等有效率多了。
questions.answer: When the bus is late, commuting by shared scooter is much more efficient than waiting at the stop.
accepted_answers: When the bus is delayed, it is much more efficient to commute by shared scooter than to wait at the bus stop.
When the bus doesn't come, riding a shared scooter to work is far more efficient than waiting at the stop.

questions.stem: 但如果有人把車亂停在人行道上，老人和小孩走路就會很危險。
questions.answer: However, if people park them anywhere on the sidewalk, it is dangerous for the elderly and children to walk there.
accepted_answers: But if someone parks the scooters anywhere on the sidewalk, it will be dangerous for old people and kids to walk by.
However, if someone parks them anywhere on the sidewalk, it can be dangerous for seniors and children to walk there.

patterns: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋for sb＋不定詞

1.explanation_zh: 「當…時」用 when 引導時間副詞子句，子句要有主詞和動詞：When the bus is late（「遲遲不來」就是誤點、一直沒來）。「騎共享機車通勤」是主詞，英文用動名詞 Commuting by shared scooter（或 Riding a shared scooter to work），動詞用單數 is。「比在站牌乾等有效率多了」是比較級：much more efficient than waiting at the (bus) stop，than 後面也用 V-ing，和主詞形式一致。
evidence: 比在站牌乾等有效率多了
1.strategy_zh: 中文句子的主詞是一個動作時，先把它變成 V-ing 或 To V；比較兩個動作時，than 前後的形式要一致。
hints: 切成四段：當公車遲遲不來時／騎共享機車通勤／比在站牌乾等／有效率多了
標的詞彙：bus（公車）、commute（通勤）、scooter（機車）、efficient（有效率的）、wait（等待）
句型框架：When + S + V, V-ing … is + much more + adj. + than V-ing …

2.explanation_zh: 「如果…」是真實條件，用 if＋現在式（If people park …），主要子句用 it is／it will be。「亂停」譯成 park them anywhere（they like）on the sidewalk。「老人和小孩走路就會很危險」不能把「老人和小孩走路」直接當主詞，要用虛主詞句型 It is dangerous for the elderly and children to walk there；「危險」用形容詞 dangerous。
evidence: 如果有人把車亂停在人行道上
老人和小孩走路就會很危險
2.strategy_zh: 中文「某人做某事＋很…」常要改成 It is＋形容詞＋for sb＋to VR；if 子句表未來仍用現在式。
hints: 切成四段：但如果有人／把車亂停在人行道上／老人和小孩走路／就會很危險
標的詞彙：park（停車）、sidewalk（人行道）、elderly（年長的）、child（小孩）、dangerous（危險的）
句型框架：If + S + V(現在式), it is/will be + adj. + for sb + to VR

references: When the bus is late, commuting by shared scooter is much more efficient than waiting at the stop.
When the bus is delayed, it is much more efficient to commute by shared scooter than to wait at the bus stop.
When the bus doesn't come, riding a shared scooter to work is far more efficient than waiting at the stop.

patterns.frame: V-ing … + is + adj. …（或 It is + adj. + to VR …）

accepted: When the bus does not come for a long time
When the bus takes too long to come
When the bus is running late

common_errors.explanation_zh: when 引導的是子句，要有動詞（is late）。

common_errors.wrong: When the bus doesn't come late
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「遲遲不來」是「一直沒來、誤點」，不是 doesn't come late。

accepted: riding a shared scooter to work
taking a shared scooter to work
to ride a shared scooter to work

common_errors.explanation_zh: 動詞片語當主詞要改成動名詞 commuting …，或用虛主詞 It is … to commute …。
「共享的」用過去分詞 shared 修飾名詞。

accepted: than to wait at the bus stop
than waiting at the bus stop
than just waiting at the bus stop
than standing at the bus stop waiting

common_errors.wrong: than wait at the bus stop
common_errors.right: than waiting at the bus stop
common_errors.explanation_zh: 比較的兩邊形式要一致：commuting … 對 waiting …（或 to commute … 對 to wait …）。

common_errors.wrong: than waiting in the bus stop
common_errors.right: than waiting at the bus stop
common_errors.explanation_zh: 在站牌、車站這種「點」用 at。
修飾比較級的 much／far 放在 more 前面。
very 不能修飾比較級，要用 much、far 或 a lot。

traps.literal_error: Ride a shared scooter to work is much more efficient than wait at the stop.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文用動詞片語當主詞，英文要改成動名詞 Commuting … 或虛主詞 It is … to commute …。

traps.literal_error: commuting by shared scooter is much more efficiency
traps.explanation_zh: be 動詞後面要接形容詞 efficient，efficiency 是名詞。

1.restructuring_zh: 「騎共享機車通勤」是動詞片語當主詞，英文要改成動名詞 Commuting by shared scooter 當主詞，或改用虛主詞 It is much more efficient to commute … than to wait …；比較的兩邊也要同形式（commuting … than waiting …）。

references: However, if people park them anywhere on the sidewalk, it is dangerous for the elderly and children to walk there.
But if someone parks the scooters anywhere on the sidewalk, it will be dangerous for old people and kids to walk by.
However, if someone parks them anywhere on the sidewalk, it can be dangerous for seniors and children to walk there.

patterns.frame: If + S + V(現在式), it is/will be …

patterns.label_zh: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋for sb＋不定詞
patterns.frame: It is + adj. + for sb + to VR …

common_errors.explanation_zh: someone／somebody 是單數，現在式動詞要加 s。
表條件的 if 子句用現在式表示未來，不加 will。

accepted: park them anywhere on the sidewalk
parks the scooters anywhere on the sidewalk
parks them anywhere on the sidewalk
park the scooters anywhere on the sidewalk
park them all over the sidewalk
leave them anywhere on the sidewalk

common_errors.wrong: park them on the sidewalk random
common_errors.right: park them anywhere on the sidewalk
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「亂停」可說 park … anywhere（they like）；random 是形容詞，不能修飾動詞。

accepted: for the elderly and children to walk
for old people and kids to walk
for seniors and children to walk
for old people and children to walk
for older people and children to walk
for the elderly and kids to walk

common_errors.wrong: old people and children walk will be dangerous
common_errors.right: it will be dangerous for old people and children to walk
common_errors.explanation_zh: 照中文語序把「老人和小孩走路」當主詞是錯的；要用虛主詞 it，把真正的主詞移到 for … to VR。

common_errors.wrong: for the elderlies and childs to walk
common_errors.right: for the elderly and children to walk
common_errors.explanation_zh: the elderly 本身就指老人（複數意義，不加 s）；child 的複數是 children。
be 動詞後面要接形容詞 dangerous，danger 是名詞。

common_errors.wrong: it is dangerous to the elderly and children walk
common_errors.right: it is dangerous for the elderly and children to walk
common_errors.explanation_zh: 虛主詞句型是 It is＋形容詞＋for sb＋to VR。

traps.literal_error: Old people and children walk will be very dangerous.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文把「老人和小孩走路」當主詞，英文要改用虛主詞 It is dangerous for … to walk。

traps.literal_error: it will be very danger for the elderly
traps.explanation_zh: 「很危險」是形容詞 dangerous，danger 是名詞。

bonus.text: Should people park them anywhere on the sidewalk, it will be dangerous for the elderly and children to walk there.
bonus.explanation_zh: 省略 if、把 should 移到句首的倒裝條件句，語氣較正式；這是加分寫法，一般寫 if 子句就能拿滿分。

2.restructuring_zh: 「老人和小孩走路就會很危險」照中文語序會寫成 Old people and children walk will be dangerous，英文要改用虛主詞：it is dangerous for the elderly and children to walk there。

1.translation: When the bus takes a long time to come, commuting on a shared scooter is much more efficient than just waiting at the bus stop.
1.explanation_zh: 「當……時」用 When 引導副詞子句；「遲遲不來」意譯為 takes a long time to come；主詞「騎共享機車通勤」用動名詞 commuting on a shared scooter；「比……有效率多了」用 much more efficient than，比較對象也要是動名詞 waiting；「乾等」用 just waiting 表達。信心 medium 是因為「遲遲不來」「乾等」各有多種譯法。

2.translation: However, if someone parks a scooter carelessly on the sidewalk, it will be very dangerous for the elderly and children to walk there.
2.explanation_zh: 「如果……」用 if 子句，主要子句用 will；「走路就會很危險」不能譯成 the elderly will be dangerous，要用 it is dangerous for sb to V 的虛主詞句型；「亂停」譯 park … carelessly；「老人」用 the elderly。

issues_zh: （小建議，不影響判定）P1 可接受寫法可補 When the bus takes a long time to come（與已列的 takes too long to come 同義）。

P2「把車亂停在人行道上」的可接受寫法只收 anywhere／all over（以及 leave them anywhere），沒有收 carelessly、wherever they like、illegally、improperly 等同樣達意的「亂停」寫法；本譯文 parks a scooter carelessly on the sidewalk 意思正確、應得分，但字面不在清單內，建議補進 accepted，以免 AI 批改把正確寫法判錯。

problems: 第 2 題驗證者對4 部分切分有意見（warn）：P2「把車亂停在人行道上」的可接受寫法只收 anywhere／all over（以及 leave them anywhere），沒有收 carelessly、wherever they like、illegally、improperly 等

1.translation: When the bus takes forever to come, riding a shared scooter to work is much more efficient than just waiting at the bus stop.
1.explanation_zh: 「遲遲不來」我用 takes forever to come（口語自然，也可用 is late）；「騎共享機車通勤」用動名詞片語當主詞；「…比…有效率多了」用 much more efficient than，than 後接 waiting 平行結構。

2.translation: But if someone parks a vehicle carelessly on the sidewalk, it will be dangerous for the elderly and children to walk there.
2.explanation_zh: if 條件句，if 子句用現在式、主要子句用 will；「亂停」譯為 parks ... carelessly；「老人和小孩走路就會很危險」用虛主詞 it is dangerous for ... to walk。中文「車」是單數或複數不明，我選單數。

issues_zh: 備註：我用 takes forever to come，與 part 1 accepted 的 takes too long to come 同義但不在清單內；視為可接受，建議補上。commute 是靠 alternatives 的 ride … to work 命中。

備註：中文「把車亂停」，參考譯文與 part 2 accepted 只收 park them／the scooters anywhere／all over，而且用 them 要靠上一句才知道指什麼；我寫 parks a vehicle carelessly，意思相同卻不在清單內。視為可接受，建議補 carelessly／illegally／improperly／randomly，以及 vehicles、their scooters 等名詞寫法。

status_reason: 判定者人工審查（第 1 輪）：評分規準太窄。第 2 題第 2 部分「把車亂停在人行道上」的 accepted 只收 anywhere／all over 一個系列，「亂停」最常見的副詞寫法（carelessly、randomly、illegally、improperly、wherever they like）全都不在可接受寫法內；兩位驗證者都獨立譯成 parks a scooter／a vehicle carelessly on the sidewalk 並建議補進（驗證者 A 判 warn），常見錯誤又只說 random 是形容詞，學生自評或對照規準時會被誤扣分。名詞也只收 them／the scooters（their scooters、scooters 沒收），而且首選譯文的 them 要靠上一句才知道指什麼（第 1 題首選譯文是不帶冠詞的 by shared scooter，沒有可讓 them 指涉的複數名詞）。重生時第 2 部分補副詞系列與名詞寫法，首選譯文改用 the scooters／their scooters。第 1 題沒有問題（第 1 部分可順便補 takes a long time／takes forever to come）。
